Refinanced over ₹1,700 Cr of projects at below 8%; operational portfolio cost of debt now ~8.5%.

operating_notes.text: Fleet-wide CUF was 30.2% in Q1FY27 versus 28.2% a year ago; wind portfolio (190 MW) CUF was 49.9%.
Days receivable outstanding stood at 19 days as on 30 June 2026.
BESS container prices closed at ~$100/kWh all-in; module prices at ₹12.1-12.2/Wp non-DCR.
Aggregate operational capacity stands at ~2,811 MWp and ~603 MWh BESS as of October 16, 2026.
The 550.6 MWp FDRE project of Juniper Green Stellar stands at 467.35 MWp and ~201 MWh BESS after commissioning 33 MW of wind on October 21, 2026.
Aggregate operational capacity is ~2,844 MWp and ~603 MWh BESS.

Juniper Green Spark Ten's 100 MW hybrid project (75 MW AC solar, 108.75 MW DC, plus 25 MW wind) in Maharashtra was fully commissioned by September 2026, ahead of the November 2026 COD, with a 25-year MSEDCL PPA at ₹3.60/kWh.
CARE expects the SPV's TD/EBITDA to stay above 5.5x over the medium term, with average DSCR of 1.5x in its base case and a two-quarter DSRA requirement.
MSEDCL payment security is an LC equal to one month's average billing; solar billing collection days have averaged under 30.
Days receivable outstanding stood at 17 days in H1FY27.
Weighted average cost of debt for the operational portfolio is 8.46% p.a.

timeline.summary: Juniper Green Energy's subsidiary Juniper Green Stellar commissioned 65.40 MW of wind power capacity, raising total operational capacity to ~2,811 MWp.
Juniper Green Energy incorporated two wholly owned subsidiaries, Juniper Green Field Fifteen Private Limited and Juniper Green Gem Fifteen Private Limited, subscribing to ₹30 lakh in shares.
Juniper Green Stellar commissioned 33 MW of wind capacity on October 21, 2026, taking the 550.6 MWp FDRE project to 467.35 MWp and group operational capacity to ~2,844 MWp.

2026-10-22: CARE Ratings assigned CARE A+; Stable to the ₹472.16 Cr long-term bank facilities of step-down subsidiary Juniper Green Spark Ten, which operates a 100 MW solar-wind hybrid project in Maharashtra.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹344.66 Cr, net profit ₹30.59 Cr.
Juniper Green Energy incorporated wholly owned subsidiary Juniper Green Beta Fifteen Private Limited with a ₹15 lakh capital subscription.
Juniper Green Energy reported a turnaround in Q2FY27 with a PAT of ₹31 Cr as operational capacity reached 2,844 MWp.

watchlist.response: No major grid risk; substations largely operational, balance capacity on STUs and CTU with substations ready.

watchlist.response: Curtailment limited to 2-2.5% on the 50 MW Bikaner merchant plant; battery expansion to 200 MWh expected to eliminate it.
BESS is embedded in FDRE contracts with a common tariff; standalone BESS not pursued as returns are low.
